notes:
- Outfits: save your VRChat avatar's toggles under a name and put them back with one press (the new Avatars page) or by saying "outfit <name>"
- Switch VRChat avatars from Saybox (Tools > Your avatars) or by saying "avatar <name>"
- Optional VRChat sign-in (Avatars page) to list your uploaded and favourite avatars; your password is never saved
